# Elephant-Referee Model (ERM)

This extension provides the ERM skills in `skills/` (erm-brainstorm, erm-protocol, erm-notebook, erm-draft, erm-review, erm-resolve, erm-drift, erm-provenance).

Apply the following only when an ERM skill is running:

- ERM_ROOT is this extension's directory. Resolve `agents/`, `resources/` and `docs/` against it.
- Start every goldfish reviewer as a **new** sub-agent with the generic prompt in `resources/standards/dispatch-standard.md`. Pass absolute paths only. Never pass the conversation, a summary of it, or the author's intent.
- If you cannot start an isolated sub-agent, stop the review and say so. Never review in your own context and call it a goldfish review.
